name: Hemdan
title: Descendant of Seir the Horite
summary: Hemdan was the firstborn son of Dishon, who was a son of Seir the Horite. He belonged to the original inhabitants of the land of Edom, known as the Horites. He is mentioned in the genealogies in Genesis and 1 Chronicles as one of the clan leaders who lived in the mountains of Seir.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Seir's Genealogy
keyEvents.description: Hemdan is mentioned as the firstborn son of Dishon in the genealogy of the Horites who lived in the land of Seir.

keyEvents.title: Clan Leaders of the Horites in Edom
keyEvents.description: Hemdan belonged to the original Horite clans who lived in the Seir mountains before Esau's descendants took over the area.

keyEvents.title: Repeated in the genealogy of Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Hemdan (called Hamran in 1 Chronicles) is mentioned again in the genealogy as one of Dishon's sons.

keyEvents.title: Horite chieftains
keyEvents.description: The Horites, including Hemdan's clan, were organized under clan leaders who ruled various areas in the land of Seir.
